svg.aria-label: Bloodlink. CI relay: lint, test, scan, trivy, ghcr, eks. PR #1 'Use O+ stock for A- patients' disqualified at test; no image built.

g.text: A blood bank system, and a pipeline that knows
FastAPI · React 19 · Postgres 16 · Helm · Terraform · EKS
Allocation is a pure function. Every commit runs lint, tests,
secret and dependency scans and a Trivy gate before an
image reaches GHCR, then deploys to EKS through GitHub
OIDC, with no stored AWS keys, and a Helm rollout that waits
PR #1 looked helpful. A compatibility test disagreed, so nothing was deployed.
PR #1 "Use O+ stock for A- patients"
